finding.title: Remove tautological 'DashboardStats model' test in parent_dashboard_aggregator_test.dart

evidence.quote: // ParentDashboardData has no mostRecentlyActive, but we test data construction

finding.why: The test constructs a ParentDashboardData literal and then asserts its fields equal the literal values it was just given — it exercises no aggregator logic. Its own inline comment admits the field it was meant to check (mostRecentlyActive) doesn't exist on the class. A broken aggregator would never fail this test.
finding.recommendation: Delete the 'DashboardStats model' group, or replace it with a real assertion against ParentDashboardAggregator.compute() output if a 'most recently active curriculum' feature is still wanted.
acceptance_criteria: No remaining test that only re-asserts constructor inputs back at itself.

finding.title: Replace string-matched PIN error localization with typed error codes (EH-5/AX-2)

evidence.quote: 'Too many failed attempts. Try again in $remainingMinutes minute(s).',

finding.why: PinFlowController.errorMessage carries raw English sentinel text (EH-5: domain/data errors must carry codes/enums, never pre-formatted messages), and PinFlowScreen._resolveError maps it back to ARB strings by exact string match, with a silent `_ => raw` fallback that renders raw English verbatim on any miss. The coupling has already drifted once undetected: the switch's 'Failed to save PIN' case matches nothing PinFlowController ever produces (only the dead pin_flow_machine.dart emitted that string — see companion dead-code finding). No test in the 628-line pin_flow_controller_test.dart or the screen test exercises _resolveError, so the next wording tweak to one file without the other silently regresses Hebrew (or English) users to wrong/raw text in a security-sensitive PIN-entry flow, undetected by CI.
finding.recommendation: Replace the free-text errorMessage field with a sealed PinFlowError enum/code on PinFlowState; have the screen switch on the enum (exhaustive switch expression, compiler-enforced) instead of string-matching English sentinels. Give PinLockoutException a stable code alongside its message. Add a widget test asserting the Locale('he') text renders for each error code.
acceptance_criteria: PinFlowState's error field is a closed enum/sealed type, not a String; pin_flow_screen.dart's switch has no fallback arm.
A test drives each PinFlowController error path and asserts the Locale('he') rendered text, not just non-null errorMessage.

finding.title: Delete unreferenced pin_flow_machine.dart (340 lines) superseded by PinFlowController

evidence.quote: /// The Riverpod adapter extends this with async fields (busy, lockedOut)

finding.why: grep -rln pin_flow_machine lib/ test/ matches only the file itself — nothing imports PinFlowSnapshot/PinFlowEvent or the state machine class. PinFlowController reimplements the same mode/step/digits/firstPin/errorMessage state machine directly instead of extending this class as the file's own doc comment claims it should. It has no test file. It is 340 lines of parallel, silently-abandoned domain logic that a future maintainer could mistake for the live implementation and edit by accident, believing they've fixed the real PIN flow.
finding.recommendation: Delete lib/features/profiles/domain/services/pin_flow_machine.dart and the now-dead 'Failed to save PIN' case in pin_flow_screen.dart's _resolveError switch.
acceptance_criteria: grep -rl pin_flow_machine lib/ test/ returns nothing.
dart analyze stays clean after removal.

finding.title: Expand pin_setup_screen_test.dart beyond a single render smoke test and rename to match PinFlowScreen
finding.why: This is the only widget-level test for PinFlowScreen (400 lines; drives setup/change/verify PIN entry, the lockout panel, and the fragile _resolveError localization mapping from the companion EH-5 finding), and it contains one 'renders without error' smoke test for setup mode only: no change/verify mode, no Locale('he') RTL variant (roughly 90 other screen test files in this codebase carry one per TQ-3), no digit-entry/lockout/error-text assertions. The filename references PinSetupScreen, a class pin_flow_screen.dart's own doc comment says was removed when setup/change/verify were unified into PinFlowScreen, so the name is stale on top of being under-tested.
finding.recommendation: Rename to pin_flow_screen_test.dart and relocate under test/features/profiles/presentation/screens/ (see companion AG-5 finding); add change/verify mode coverage, a Locale('he') pump, and a driven wrong-PIN/lockout interaction asserting resolved (not raw) error text.
acceptance_criteria: test/features/profiles/presentation/screens/pin_flow_screen_test.dart exists with setup+change+verify mode coverage and a Locale('he') pump.

finding.title: Use addTearDown(container.dispose) in pin_flow_controller_test.dart's async/setup-transition tests
finding.why: Every other group in this file creates its container with addTearDown(container.dispose) immediately after construction, per TQ-2, guaranteeing cleanup even when an expect() throws. The 5 tests in the 'verify mode (async)' and 'setup mode step transitions' groups (lines ~424-435, 442-454, 463-474, 579-599, 604-625) instead call container.dispose() as the last statement in the test body — if any expect() before it fails, the container and its pending bcrypt/timer callbacks leak into the rest of the suite.
finding.recommendation: Add addTearDown(container.dispose) immediately after each of the 5 `final container = _makeContainer(...)` calls in these two groups; drop the trailing manual container.dispose() calls.
acceptance_criteria: No test in the file calls container.dispose() as its last statement; every container has a paired addTearDown at construction.
